desc: In May 2021 Luis Elizondo filed a complaint with the Department of Defense Office of Inspector General alleging what he described as 'malicious activities, coordinated disinformation, professional misconduct, whistleblower reprisal and explicit threats' and writing that the actions taken against him 'directly erode the very foundation of national security ethos and the public trust instilled by the American people.' He named three officials: Garry Reid, then Director for Defense Intelligence at OUSD(I); Susan Gough, the Department's UAP spokesperson; and Neill Tipton, Director for Defense Intelligence for Collection and Special Programs. Reporting associated with the complaint alleges Reid threatened his security clearance, orchestrated an Air Force investigation into the video releases even though the videos were unclassified, and used administrative measures to block his access to Pentagon facilities. FOIA releases have since produced a 103-page transcript of the DoD IG's February 2023 interview of Elizondo, 126 pages of DoD IG emails about UAP and Elizondo released in February 2024, and 40 further pages in March 2025. No public adjudication of Elizondo's complaint has been released.
